description: Rewrite the tailored resume or cover letter of applications that are not sent yet, from the user's instructions. Pass 1 to 25 application_ids from getmattered_get_applications, document_type ("resume" or "cover_letter") and instructions in the user's own words. The rewritten document replaces the one saved on each application and is shown in the answer. Nothing is sent to the employer. Uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to rewrite the base resume on the account; use getmattered_optimize_resume, then getmattered_set_resume. Next: getmattered_approve_applications when the user is happy with the result.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from getmattered_get_applications

document_type.description: "resume" or "cover_letter": which document of each application to rewrite.

instructions.description: What to change, in the user's own words (up to 2,000 characters).

name: getmattered_refine_application_documents

decision.description: The operation that ran: approve, reject, cancel, refine, re_prepare or set_stage.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action. Never proof the employer received it.

title: Rewrite Application Documents
